prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign into your existing account to restore saved pets and desktop progress."]
1: ["Preparing your pet for your desktop. If your pet does not appear within 2 minutes, check your taskbar or app permissions."]
2: ["Desktop Pet Quick Controls", "Learn how to interact with, hide, or summon your desktop pet at any time.", "Double click pet to open quick menu. Right-click to hide to tray.", "Got it!"]
3: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Choose how you want to create and personalize your desktop pet."]
4: ["Meet Your New Companion", "Select a starter pet to companion you on your desktop."]
5: ["Sign In to Save Companion Progress"]
6: ["Your Pet is Ready for Work & Play", "Here is a quick overview of how your pet lives on your desktop screen.", "Drag your pet anywhere on screen. Right-click for options.", "Start Exploring"]
7: ["Upload clear, well-lit photos facing forward for best pet generation results."]
8: ["Choose Your Setup Path (Takes ~2 min)", "Select whether to pick a pre-made pet or create your own custom companion."]
9: ["Creating Your Desktop Pet..."]
